item.title: Application total cost of ownership: Gain transparency, make informed decisions (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: SAP LeanIX adds application total cost of ownership (TCO) capabilities to capture application cost data, surface key cost drivers, and quantify rationalization opportunities. These capabilities can help enterprise architects bring cost transparency to their application portfolios and make faster, more data-backed decisions on application rationalization. Available today to all SAP LeanIX customers.

item.title: Post-merger integration: Removing risk, ensuring value (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: You've probably heard the oft-cited statistic that 70% of mergers and acquisitions fail to achieve their projected value. Indeed, research over the years suggested that failure rate might be as high as 90%. In most cases. it was said, the cause was overvaluation or overpayment for the acquired entity.

item.title: How Agoda Unified Multiple Data Pipelines into a Single Source of Truth (Source: feed.infoq.com)
item.description:
Agoda recently described how it consolidated multiple independent data pipelines into a centralized Apache Spark-based platform to eliminate inconsistencies in financial data. The company implemented a multi-layered quality framework that combines automated validations, machine-learning-based anomaly detection, and data contracts, while processing millions of daily booking transactions.

By Eran Stiller
